confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'It is not normal for food to freeze solid after two days... The most likely cause now is a defrost system fault'

blockingLoop.evidence: 'Please switch it off at the socket, leave doors open until all ice has melted' repeated in three consecutive turns despite the customer's pushback

rationale: The opening turns were sound: it correctly identified the max dial setting and food pressed against the rear vents as the likely cause and the customer saw real improvement. It then went badly off course, insisting with false certainty that one yoghurt freezing after only two days proved a 'defrost system fault' (which would make the fridge warmer, not colder), repeatedly demanding a 24-hour manual defrost of a frost-free appliance, and giving a self-contradictory rationale when the customer rightly questioned it. It never suggested a thermometer, never mentioned the damper/thermostat possibility or an engineer, and gave poor food-safety advice ('no need to wait for it to cool down') while ignoring that unplugging the whole unit for 24 hours thaws a freezer full of shopping.
